An '''Enrichment Zone''' was a protected piece of land on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. Since [[Mining/Legends|mining]] was the main industry of Bandomeer, there were many strip mines which left the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] resources limited. The government set up Enrichment Zones to re-cultivate the dead soil. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agri Corps]] helped by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to create [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life.
